data.body: Created and linked audit task minimum-rainy-fawn. Declared no repository file impact because this phase produces only a proposal. The operator clarified that code-review protocol was outside scope, so the survey now follows the supplied documentation taxonomy with agent-coordination only. The first plan review returned BLOCK because the standards source was not durable in the ticket. Revised the description to preserve the full standards baseline, cite docs/maintenance-audit-runbook.md, explain the shard rationale, and separate acceptance criteria. No project files changed.
